{{Quote|Hokey religions and ancient weapons are no match for a good blaster at your side, kid.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Atheism''' was the disbelief in a god, gods or [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Nom Anor]], a [[Yuuzhan Vong]], whose [[Species/Legends|species]] were notable for an obsession with their gods, was an atheist.
